caseName: Federal Election Commission v. National Conservative Political Action Committee
caseNameFull: Federal Election Commission v. National Conservative Political Action Committee and Democratic Party of the United States v. National Conservative Political Action Committee

opinions.text: D. C. E. D. Pa. [Probable jurisdiction noted, 466 U. S. 935.] Motion of Democratic National Committee for divided argument granted to be divided as follows: Federal Election Commission, 20 minutes; and Democratic National Committee, 10 minutes.
